case_name: Criminal Law Mapping: IPC to BNS
act_section: Indian Penal Code to Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita
description: Mapping of major offences from Indian Penal Code (IPC) to Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).
content: Murder: IPC 302 -> BNS 103(1). Attempt to Murder: IPC 307 -> BNS 109. Dowry Death: IPC 304B -> BNS 80. Rape: IPC 375/376 -> BNS 63/64. Cruelty: IPC 498A -> BNS 85. Theft: IPC 379 -> BNS 303. Cheating: IPC 420 -> BNS 318. Criminal Breach of Trust: IPC 406 -> BNS 316. Extortion: IPC 384 -> BNS 308. Conspiracy: IPC 120B -> BNS 61. Sedition: IPC 124A -> BNS 152 (Acts endangering sovereignty). Common Intention: IPC 34 -> BNS 3(5). New specific offences in BNS include: Mob Lynching -> BNS 103(2). Snatching -> BNS 304. Terrorism -> BNS 113. Organized Crime -> BNS 111.

case_name: Criminal Law Mapping: CrPC to BNSS
act_section: Code of Criminal Procedure to Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita
description: Mapping of major procedural sections from CrPC to BNSS.
content: Arrest without warrant: CrPC 41 -> BNSS 35. Information in cognizable cases (FIR): CrPC 154 -> BNSS 173. Quashing of proceedings (Inherent powers of High Court): CrPC 482 -> BNSS 528. Regular Bail: CrPC 439 -> BNSS 483. Anticipatory Bail: CrPC 438 -> BNSS 482. Pre-cognizance hearing requirement for the accused: newly introduced under BNSS 223.

case_name: Criminal Law Mapping: Evidence Act to BSA
act_section: Indian Evidence Act to Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam
description: Mapping of major evidentiary rules from Indian Evidence Act (IEA) to Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA).
content: Dying Declaration: IEA 32(1) -> BSA 26(a). Confession to Police Officer not to be proved: IEA 25 -> BSA 23. Admissibility of Electronic Records: IEA 65B -> BSA 63.
